name: Food Recipe Ingredient Substitution Ontology Design Pattern
description: Diagram | Intent: | To model substitutes for ingredients in food recipes. Essential aspects of modelling substitutes are their quantity in a recipe, the constraints and the quali...
competency_questions: For the recipe covered by an ingredient substitution, how much of each listed ingredient does it call for, and in which unit?; Under which dietary, cultural or technological restrictions does a given ingredient swap hold, and what is the swap meant to achieve?; Which taste or dietary properties does a given food ingredient have, and which measured value and unit record each one?
competency_questions_source: derived from the pattern's own axioms during the OntoBoard 1.127.0 review and checked against them; the upstream submission states none
